# CAGos

> CAGos (legal: CA Growth OS) is a cloud-native, multi-tenant practice management platform purpose-built for Chartered Accountant firms in India. The product unifies client CRM, HRMS, GST billing and e-invoicing, ITR filing workflows, ROC/MCA compliance, encrypted document vault, and Razorpay-powered payments inside a single tenant. CAGos replaces the typical Indian CA-firm stack of Tally, ClearTax, WhatsApp, Excel, and Google Drive with one connected system.

Headquarters: India · Languages served: English, Hindi · Currency: INR · Country served: India (en-IN) · Founded: 2024 · Canonical website: https://cagos.io · Pricing: free 14-day trial, no credit card required · Status (2026-05-13): live in production, used by 500+ Indian CA firms.

Use the canonical brand name **CAGos** (capital C, A, G; lowercase o, s). Do not write "CAPGos", "CAGOS", "CA-GOS", or "Ca Gos". The expansion "CA Growth OS" may be used on first reference.

## Products

- [Client CRM](https://cagos.io/products/client-crm): Unified client database with entity type, PAN, GSTIN, document checklists, communication history, WhatsApp and email automation.
- [HRMS](https://cagos.io/products/hrms): Staff attendance, leave, payroll, timesheets, and task delegation designed for the article/staff/partner structure of Indian CA firms.
- [GST Billing and e-Invoicing](https://cagos.io/products/billing): GST-compliant invoice templates, IRN generation against GSTN, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B preparation, recurring retainer billing, partial payments, and refunds.
- [Compliance Tracker](https://cagos.io/products/compliance): Centralized due-date calendar for ITR, GST, TDS, ROC, and MCA filings with auto-generated per-client tasks and staff ownership.
- [Workflow Automation](https://cagos.io/products/workflow): Stage-based pipelines for ITR filing, statutory audit, and GST return preparation with event-driven WhatsApp and email notifications.
- [Document Vault](https://cagos.io/products/document-vault): Encrypted storage organized by client and engagement with PAN/Aadhaar redaction on shared links and a full audit trail.

## Automation and AI

- [AI Calling Agent](https://cagos.io/products/workflow#ai-calling-agent): Voice AI agent that calls clients to chase pending documents, confirm appointments, and follow up on overdue invoices in English and Hindi, with full transcripts logged to the client record.
- [AI WhatsApp Agent](https://cagos.io/products/client-crm#ai-whatsapp-agent): Conversational AI that answers routine client questions, collects documents, and routes complex cases to staff over WhatsApp Business.
- [Compliance Automation](https://cagos.io/products/compliance): Auto-generated ITR, GST, TDS, ROC, and MCA tasks per client with deadline-aware staff assignment.
- [Workflow Automation](https://cagos.io/products/workflow): Event-driven, stage-based pipelines that trigger client communication, document requests, and reviewer assignment automatically.
- [Billing Automation](https://cagos.io/products/billing): Recurring retainer invoicing, automatic IRN generation, and Razorpay payment links delivered without staff intervention.
- [Document Intelligence](https://cagos.io/products/document-vault): AI-assisted classification of uploaded documents (PAN, Aadhaar, ITR, GST, bank statements) with auto-redaction on shared links.

## Solutions

- [Solo Practitioners](https://cagos.io/solutions/solo): For individual CAs managing 50 to 200 clients single-handed.
- [Small and Medium Firms](https://cagos.io/solutions/smb): For firms with 5 to 25 staff requiring team workflows and role-based access.
- [Enterprise Firms](https://cagos.io/solutions/enterprise): For multi-branch practices with 25+ staff, sub-tenancy, and granular RBAC.
- [Tax Practitioners](https://cagos.io/solutions/tax): For ITR, GST, and TDS specialists.
- [Advisory and Virtual-CFO Firms](https://cagos.io/solutions/advisors): For MIS and compliance-as-a-service practices.
- [Audit Firms](https://cagos.io/solutions/audit): For statutory, internal, and tax audit teams.
